title: feat(app-shell): Studio authors relatedList, the related-list block's columns/sort/filter, ordered highlight fields, and slotted-by-default record pages
body:
Part of #27054. This PR lands four of the card's five Studio items. The card's `relatedLists` drag-to-order editor stays open on the card: it waits for #27069 to ship the key, as the card and the dispatch both say.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio 现在能直接编辑记录页 v3 读取的几项元数据。查找/主从字段有「关联列表」三态控件（显示 / 不显示 / 主要（进正文））和筛选构建器；关联列表块露出列、排序、筛选、条数、「查看全部」、添加；重点字段变成可拖排序的有序列表（上限 6）带要点条预览；新建记录页默认是空槽的 slotted 页，「转成整页」是显式按钮。
- **为什么改**：这些键 spec 早已声明、记录页也在读，但 Studio 没有控件，作者只能手写 JSON；新建记录页还会把合成页整份拷进去，从第一天起就和默认页分叉。
- **风险与回滚**：只动 Studio 前端（app-shell）与 studio 文案包，不改任何 spec schema、不碰记录页运行时渲染。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`（`RelatedListFields`）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview.tsx`（`convertToFull`，写回的是 spec 认可的落盘形状）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.ts`（新建页 seed）。
- **两分钟验证**：在 Studio 打开 showcase 的 Invoice，点 Account 列的编辑按钮，字段面板下方应看到「Related list on the parent record」三态控件，「Primary (in body)」处于选中；截图见证据分支 `claude/issue-27054-evidence`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

1. **Field inspector: related list on the parent record.** On a `lookup` or `master_detail` field, a new section edits the two keys that describe the child collection on the parent's record page.
   - A three-state control writes `relatedList`. "Don't show" writes `false` and "Primary (in body)" writes `'primary'`. "Show" leaves the key absent, the spec's own "true or absent = shown"; a stored `true` reads as Show.
   - `relatedListFilter` is edited with the same builder the dataset designer uses over the list toolbar's `FilterBuilder`. That field is now one shared component, `FilterConditionField`, moved out of the dataset inspector rather than copied. A stored filter the flat builder cannot hold (nested, OR) is kept as stored and named.
   - The section is absent on `tree` fields, which the spec gives no related list.
2. **`record:related_list` block inspector.** The block now curates `columns`, `sort`, `filter`, `limit`, `showViewAll` and `add`, beside `objectName`, `relationshipField` and `title`. Every one is a prop `RecordRelatedListProps` already declares.
   - `columns`, `sort` and `filter` read the child object named by `objectName`. `filter` uses the list toolbar's builder (the `filter-builder` form widget's own field, now exported), so it writes spec `ViewFilterRule[]`.
   - `showViewAll` shows the spec default (on) when unset. `add` is a JSON box with a shape sample, the only door that can add that nested key.
   - A stored value in the other arm of a union is shown as JSON rather than dropped into the row editor: a string `sort`, or `columns` given as saved-view column objects.
   - The limit hint reads 5, the renderer's own default, instead of 10.
3. **Object settings: `highlightFields` as an ordered list.** Rows can be dragged or moved with up and down buttons (the keyboard path). Fields are appended up to six, and a longer stored list is shown whole. A strip preview below draws the picked order. Removing the last field removes the key. The editor is `HighlightFieldsEditor` in `studio-design`.
4. **New record pages start slotted.** In the metadata page-create form, the kind now follows the page type until the author picks one: `record` gives `slotted`, everything else `full`. This is a new `page-kind` create-derive transform.
   - A record page is created `kind: 'slotted'` with no slots, which renders as the synthesized default and keeps following the object.
   - The synthesized regions are copied only when the author explicitly asks for a full page: by choosing `full` at create, or with the designer's new "Convert to full page" action.
   - That action re-synthesizes the regions in the persisted shape (field names, English default heading), exactly as the create-time seed does. It then switches the kind to `full` and drops `slots`.
   - An empty slotted page now opens on the slot editor with every slot inherited. Before, it opened a blank regions canvas whose "Add region" wrote regions a slotted page never reads.

## Why

The record-page v3 epic makes the record page read these keys, and the spec already declares all of them, but Studio had no control for most of them. Authors had to hand-write JSON, or had no door at all: `relatedList` had no control, and the block's column, sort and filter props were absent. A new record page was seeded with a copy of the synthesized page, so every authored page forked from the default on the day it was created. The maintainer's rulings on the card fix the shape of each control.

## Tests

All test runs are on head `23a697c2` (after merging `main`), run from the repository root.

- New pins:
  - `ObjectFieldInspector.relatedList-27054.test.tsx`: 「主要」 on the task → lead FK writes `'primary'`, and the lead page built by the real `deriveRelatedLists` and `buildDefaultPageSchema` chain lists tasks first. Before the click, the control order is notes first.
  - `PageBlockInspector.relatedListProps-27054.test.tsx`: columns, filter and limit round-trip, and every written block passes `ComponentPropsMap['record:related_list']`.
  - `ObjectSettingsPanel.highlightOrder-27054.test.tsx`: order is preserved through buttons, drag and add, plus the cap of six.
  - `PagePreview.slottedDefault-27054.test.tsx` and `anchors.page-seed.test.ts`: a new record page is `kind: 'slotted'` with empty slots and passes `PageSchema`. Convert-to-full and full-create both write blocks that pass their spec props rows.
- Re-pinned (patch round 1, head `7731242e37`): `recordDetailSections.agreement-12442.test.ts` — the seed-and-runtime agreement now holds on the explicit-`full` path (`fullSeedFor`), and a new case pins that a record page created with no kind or `slotted` seeds exactly `{ kind: 'slotted' }` with no `record:details` node; the three-call-sites block is unchanged.
- Updated pins:
  - `block-config-i18n.test.ts`: one more add button, one more literal placeholder, and the limit literal is now 5.
  - `block-config.test.ts`: the new `filter-rules` kind.
  - `block-config-schema-parity-8216.test.ts`: the census now judges the row editor's element through the single array arm of a `string | array` union, which is more coverage, not less.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live verification found and fixed a defect in this branch.** The first version of "Convert to full page" copied the canvas's render schema, whose detail sections hold runtime field objects. On a real showcase page the converted draft drew a 16-error spec banner. The action now writes the persisted shape, and the props-row pin above reproduces the original error when the fix is ablated.
- **Primary's wording follows the v3 ruling.** The label is "Primary (in body)" / 「主要（进正文）」 and the help text describes a full-width table in the record body. That rendering is #27069's half; until it lands, the runtime still promotes a primary list to its own tab. The dispatch asked the help text to cite #27069, but runtime strings carry no tracker number in this repo, so the reference sits in the code comment on `RelatedListFields`.
- **"Show" leaves `relatedList` absent rather than writing `true`.** The spec reads both the same, and the inspector's convention is that unset deletes the key.
- **The Setup metadata drawer's `relatedListFilter` row is still a JSON box.** The spec's field form (`field.form.ts`) renders there through `SchemaForm`, which has no object-field context in that drawer. Plumbing one would also re-bind every `*Field` row of the field form to the wrong object: `displayField` names a field of the referenced object. The filter builder is in the Studio field inspector, where the three-state control lives, so `field.form.ts` and `page.form.ts` are unchanged.
- **The file surface differs from the card.** `block-config.ts` and `PageBlockInspector.tsx` live under `metadata-admin/` (previews and inspectors), and `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` under `studio-design/`. The fix also touches `PagePreview.tsx`, `PageBlockCanvas.tsx`, `createDerive.ts`, `registry.ts`, `widgets.tsx` (one export) and `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx` (the shared filter field moved out). New files are `FilterConditionField.tsx` and `HighlightFieldsEditor.tsx`.
- **Observed, not fixed (pre-existing).** In the page designer canvas, an authored `record:details` that names its fields draws a location field as "[Object]" and a select value raw. This is the same output the existing full-create seed already produces on `main`. Another is that `PageBlockInspector`'s JSON fields render a `Label` that is not associated with their textarea.

## Verification

- Screenshots are on the never-merged branch [`claude/issue-27054-evidence`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/tree/claude/issue-27054-evidence). They come from a local showcase app (`--fresh` database) running this branch.
  - The field inspector on `showcase_invoice.account` with 「Primary (in body)」 selected.
  - The page-create form switching Kind to `slotted` for a record page.
  - The designer's default-page note and "Convert to full page".
  - The converted page saved with no spec banner.
  - The ordered highlight list with its strip preview.
- Local gates: the cloud run's gate block is in report comment 6464856235 on the card (head `23a697c2`), the patch round's in 6466884994 (head `7731242e37`; 34 / 34 derived, the `vitest run scripts/` red is the macOS host gap). CI on `7731242e37`: all nine required contexts success, Test UI 16 / 16 shards.
- Final head: `7731242e37` (the cloud head `23a697c2` merged with `main` `b8615afaba` plus the re-pin).

- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint over the changed files reports no new error.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer brief and quoted rulings excepted).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
